summary.tldr: Adds a right to proper housing at a reasonable cost and free of unreasonable barriers to the Canadian Bill of Rights.
what_it_does: Adds to the Canadian Bill of Rights a right to proper housing at a reasonable cost and free of unreasonable barriers.
Brings the change into force on the first anniversary of royal assent.
summary.background: The bill amends section 1 of the Canadian Bill of Rights by adding a new paragraph on housing rights.
